correctness.rationale: Distributional full-line Green function gives two positive attenuation slopes and amplitudes. Subtracting the two positive-root identities and eliminating common source amplitude yields R=(k1+z)/(k2-z), z=D(k2-k1)^2/(u1-u2), strictly monotone for 0<z<k2-k1. This proves the exact feasibility test and explicit unique inversion. A continuous free-parameter family for 2+1 readings proves sharp minimality; full one-flow curve also has a two-dimensional ambiguity. Rational witness and 12,000 seeded inverse tests supplement but do not replace analytic proof. Source: RESULT.md and verify.py.

value.rationale: Tide-dependent eDNA attenuation with a known point source is a documented experimental question (Baetscher et al. 2024). The four parameters represent distinct biological/physical mechanisms; the new theorem gives a complete feasibility and minimal-design benchmark and shows why an arbitrarily dense one-condition transect cannot separate them. The exact strength is conditional on an idealized common emission and steady two-phase model, with no implied field validation.
